sentences.text: The petitioner, namely, Moktadul Rahman, was arrested on 04.06.2024 in connection with Bogribari Police Station Case No. 51/2024 registered under Sections 448/376(3)/506 IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act, corresponding to G.R. No. 255/2024.
It is seen that Charge-Sheet in the case was filed under Sections 448/376(3)/506 IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act on 30.06.2024.

Call for the scanned legible copy of the records of the relevant Special (POCSO) Case accordingly registered before the learned Special Judge (POCSO), Kokrajhar arising out of said Bogribari Police Station Case No. 51/2024 corresponding to G.R. No. 255/2024.

List on 02.12.2024 and on the said date, the Officer-in-Charge of Bogribari Police Station through the Public Prosecutor shall apprise the Court about the status of service of notice on the respondent No.2/informant of the case.
